name: openbb_equity_screener
description:
Stock screener through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.screener).
Returns: {results_count, results: [records with symbol, name, market cap, sector, price and provider extras]} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): sector; country (e.g. US); limit (integer; sent only when given); market_cap_min and market_cap_max (integers, sent under those names, but OpenBB 4.6 calls them mktcap_min and mktcap_max, so they may have no effect); provider (fmp, nasdaq or yfinance; default fmp).
Ready-made lists: openbb_equity_discovery_gainers, openbb_equity_discovery_losers, openbb_equity_discovery_active; another screener: fmp_stock_screener. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"sector": "technology", "country": "US", "limit": 20, "provider": "yfinance"}
